question: The 51st G7 summit was held in which of the following countries in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Canada**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **51st G7 Summit** is scheduled to take place in **June 2025**, hosted by **Canada**.
 
• Canada, as a founding member of the **Group of Seven (G7)**, has hosted numerous G7 summits in the past. Its selection for hosting the 51st summit aligns with its active participation in global economic and geopolitical discussions.
 
• The **G7 Summit** is an annual meeting attended by the heads of state or government of the world’s most advanced economies, including the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Japan, and Canada, along with representatives from the European Union.
 
• The summits primarily focus on key global challenges such as **economic growth, international trade, climate change, security, and human rights**.
 
• The venue for the summit in Canada has yet to be officially announced but is expected to be a location capable of accommodating high-level diplomatic discussions, ensuring security, and showcasing Canada’s cultural heritage and natural beauty.
